question.en: Which tip covers the whole apex area and over half the nail plate?
question.zh: 哪种甲片能盖住整个甲峰区域，通常超过半个甲面？

explanation.en: A full-well tip covers the entire apex area, usually more than half the nail plate. A partial-well tip has a shorter well, so more natural nail shows.
explanation.zh: full-well tip（全凹槽甲片）盖住整个甲峰区域，通常超过半个甲面。partial-well tip（半凹槽甲片）的凹槽较短，露出更多真甲。

lockPoint.en: Full = all, partial = part, -less = none: the name tells you how much well the tip has.
lockPoint.zh: full = 全部，partial = 一部分，-less = 没有：名字就告诉你甲片有多少凹槽。

authorityRefs.section: Nail Tips and Forms - Nail Tips

evidence.quote: A full-well tip (FULL-WELL TIP) covers the entire apex area and usually covers more than half of the nail plate.
is usually altered at the well line to expose more of the natural nail. The well is shorter than a standard full-well tip.

question.en: When first placing a nail tip, at what angle do you hold it?
question.zh: 开始贴甲片时，甲片要拿成多少度角？

explanation.en: Hold the tip at a 45-degree angle and connect the position stop to the free edge. Then press down slowly, watching the resin move through the well.
explanation.zh: 把甲片拿成 45 度角，让定位点（position stop）对准真甲的游离缘（free edge）。然后慢慢往下压，看着胶在凹槽里推开。

lockPoint.en: Lay your hand flat, then point it straight up. Halfway between is 45 degrees: start the tip there.
lockPoint.zh: 把手平放，再竖直朝上。两者正中间就是 45 度：甲片就从这个角度开始贴。

authorityRefs.section: Nail Tips and Forms - Full- or Partial-Well Nail Tip Application

evidence.quote: Hold the tip at a 45-degree angle and connect the position stop in the well to the free edge of the natural nail.
Slowly press down toward the nail plate, watching the resin move through the well. Avoid getting air bubbles in the contact area.

question.en: A nail tip went on crooked. What should you do?
question.zh: 甲片贴歪了，应该怎么做？

choices.en: Soak it off, then apply a new tip
Pry it off with a pusher
Leave it; the overlay will hide it
File it straight with a coarse file

explanation.en: Milady: soak the nail in acetone for 5 to 10 minutes, slide the soft tip off, and reapply. Prying it off (forcing it up) can damage the nail plate.
explanation.zh: Milady 的做法：把指甲泡在丙酮（acetone）里 5 到 10 分钟，把变软的甲片滑下来，再重新贴。硬撬（prying，用力撬起来）会伤到甲板。

lockPoint.en: Like a shirt buttoned wrong: you don't pull harder. You undo it and start again.
lockPoint.zh: 就像衬衫扣错了扣子：不是更用力地拉，而是解开重新扣。

authorityRefs.section: Nail Tips and Forms - Full- or Partial-Well Nail Tip Application
Nail Tips and Forms - Nail Tip Removal
Nail Tips and Forms - Nail Tip Removal

evidence.quote: If a nail is applied crooked, see Procedure 9–4: Tip Removal.

Reapply the nail tip as directed in Procedure 9–2 or proceed with the desired service.

question.en: After soaking a wrap or dip nail, how do you remove the softened product?
question.zh: 包甲或浸粉甲泡软后，怎样去掉变软的产品？

choices.en: Pry it up with a pusher
Slide it off with a wooden pusher
choices.zh: 用木棒（wooden pusher）把它推下来

explanation.en: Wraps and dips are both resin systems, removed the same way. Soak in acetone or product remover, then gently slide the soft product off. Prying (forcing it up) can damage the nail.
explanation.zh: 包甲（wrap）和浸粉（dip）都是树脂系统，卸除方法一样。泡在丙酮或卸甲液里，再轻轻把变软的产品滑下来。硬撬（prying，用力撬起来）会伤到指甲。

lockPoint.en: Softened product, gentle tool: a wooden pusher just slides it off. No cutting, no prying, no peeling.
lockPoint.zh: 产品已经变软，就用温和的工具：木推棒轻轻一推就滑下来。不剪、不撬（prying）、不剥。

authorityRefs.section: Nail Resin Systems - Nail Resin System Removal
Nail Resin Systems - Nail Resins

evidence.quote: Use a wooden pusher to slide off the softened product.
Be careful not to pry off the product, because you can damage the nail.
Resin systems are easily removed by soaking in, or wrapping the nails with, acetone or product remover.
This makes them an excellent option for special events, such as proms and weddings

question.en: Compared with a thick nail resin, a thin resin
question.zh: 和较稠的甲用树脂相比，较稀的树脂

choices.en: is used to build the apex.
always needs an accelerator to cure.
choices.zh: 一定要用加速剂才能固化。

explanation.en: Viscosity means how thick the resin is. The thinner it is, the better it sticks and the faster it cures. Thin resin is a base. Thick resin is for building or a topcoat.
explanation.zh: viscosity（黏度）就是树脂的稠度。越稀，附着越好、固化越快。稀的树脂做底层。稠的树脂用来做结构或当封层。

lockPoint.en: Water vs. honey: water runs into tiny gaps fast. Thin resin acts like water: sticks better, cures faster.
lockPoint.zh: 水和蜂蜜比：水很快就流进细小的缝隙。稀的树脂就像水：粘得更好，固化更快。

authorityRefs.section: Nail Resin Systems - Nail Resins

evidence.quote: The thinner the viscosity, the better the adhesion and faster time to cure.
Thinner viscosity resins are usually used as a base; thicker viscosity resins are used to build or are applied as a topcoat
Very thin cyanoacrylates may be referred to as nail glue or tip adhesive.
Some resins may be so viscous that they require a resin accelerator to cure

question.en: Between enhancement product and the living skin, leave a free margin of about
question.zh: 美甲产品和活皮肤之间，要留出大约多宽的空隙？

explanation.en: Milady says to always leave a tiny free margin, about 1/16 inch, from the living skin. Each time product touches skin, the risk of skin sensitization goes up.
explanation.zh: Milady 要求产品和活皮肤之间永远留一条很小的空隙（free margin），约 1/16 英寸。产品每碰一次皮肤，致敏（sensitization）的风险就增加一次。

lockPoint.en: 1/16 inch is about the thickness of a penny: tiny, but enough to keep product off the skin.
lockPoint.zh: 1/16 英寸大约是一枚一美分硬币的厚度：很小，但足够让产品不碰到皮肤。

authorityRefs.section: Skin Structure, Disorders, and Diseases - Prolonged or Repeated Contact Risks

question.en: Which mix ratio makes a wet bead?
question.zh: 哪种液粉比（mix ratio）做出的是湿球（wet bead）？

explanation.en: Equal parts make a dry bead. Twice as much liquid as powder makes a wet bead. The medium bead, halfway between, is usually the ideal mix.
explanation.zh: 液粉等量是干球（dry bead）；液体是粉的两倍是湿球（wet bead）。介于两者之间的中球（medium bead）通常最理想。

lockPoint.en: Mix dirt with twice as much water and you get wet, runny mud. Twice the liquid makes a wet bead.
lockPoint.zh: 土里加两倍的水，就成了又湿又稀的泥。液体加到两倍，就是湿球（wet bead）。

authorityRefs.section: Monomer Liquid and Polymer Powder Nail Enhancements - Monomer Liquid
Monomer Liquid and Polymer Powder Nail Enhancements - One-Color Monomer Liquid and Polymer Powder Overlay

evidence.quote: If twice as much liquid as powder is used to create the bead, it is called a wet bead.
If equal amounts of liquid and powder are used to create the bead, it is called a dry bead.
Pick up a small wet bead of polymer powder with your brush and place it just above the center of the nail plate. Tap the product up toward the cuticle

question.en: Which monomer liquid is an industry standard for liquid and powder nails?
question.zh: 做水晶甲（liquid and powder）时，哪种单体液是行业标准？

explanation.en: Milady names EMA and odorless monomer liquid as the industry standard. MMA is not recommended for nails and is illegal in most states.
explanation.zh: Milady 说行业标准是 EMA（甲基丙烯酸乙酯）和无味单体液。MMA 不建议用在指甲上，而且在大多数州是违法的。

lockPoint.en: EMA and MMA differ by one letter. Polymer powder is also made mostly from EMA.
lockPoint.zh: EMA 和 MMA 只差一个字母。聚合物粉也主要是用 EMA 做的。

authorityRefs.section: Monomer Liquid and Polymer Powder Nail Enhancements - Chemistry of Liquid and Powder
Monomer Liquid and Polymer Powder Nail Enhancements - Chemistry of Liquid and Powder

evidence.quote: The industry standard is the ethyl methacrylate monomer (EMA) and odorless monomer liquid.
methyl methacrylate (MMA) is not recommended for use on nails and is illegal according to the state board rules in most states.
polymer powder is also made mostly from ethyl methacrylate monomer liquid.

question.en: When floating a bead of gel over the nail, which way do you move it?
question.zh: 把一颗凝胶在指甲上推开铺平（float）时，往哪个方向推？

choices.en: From the cuticle toward the free edge
From the free edge toward the cuticle
From one sidewall to the other
In small circles from the center

explanation.en: Milady: start at the cuticle and float the gel toward the free edge to cover the whole nail. Do not let it touch the skin, or it will lift.
explanation.zh: Milady 的做法：从甲小皮开始，把胶朝游离缘推开，盖满整个指甲。不要碰到皮肤，否则会起翘。

lockPoint.en: Like a playground slide: start at the top (the cuticle) and go down to the end (the free edge).
lockPoint.zh: 就像玩滑梯：从顶上（甲小皮）开始，一路滑到底（游离缘）。

authorityRefs.section: Gel Nail Enhancements - Using Gels
Monomer Liquid and Polymer Powder Nail Enhancements - One-Color Monomer Liquid and Polymer Powder Overlay

evidence.quote: float it across the nail by starting at the cuticle and floating it toward the free edge to cover the entire nail surface.
Be sure not to contact the skin, as this will cause lifting.
Tap the product up toward the cuticle, as close as you can without touching the skin

question.en: In a dip service, when do you first apply activator?
question.zh: 做浸粉时，什么时候第一次上激活剂（activator）？

choices.en: Before the first coat of base resin
After every single dip into powder
Only at the end, over top resin
choices.zh: 只在最后，涂在封层树脂上

choices.en: After two to three coats of color
choices.zh: 上了两到三层颜色之后

explanation.en: Once the nail has two to three applications of color, apply activator to help the layers dry. Activator is another name for resin accelerator.
explanation.zh: 指甲上了两到三层颜色后，上激活剂（activator）帮助各层变干。activator 就是树脂加速剂（resin accelerator）的另一个名字。

lockPoint.en: Not after every dip: build two to three coats of color first, then activator dries the layers together.
lockPoint.zh: 不是每蘸一次粉就上：先叠两到三层颜色，再用激活剂（activator）让这些层一起变干。

authorityRefs.section: Nail Resin Systems - Dip Systems
Nail Resin Systems - Nail Resins
Nail Resin Systems - Nail Repair Using a Fabric Wrap

evidence.quote: Once you get two to three applications of color on the nail, you will need to apply an activator to help the layers dry.
or activator, assists in speeding up the dry time of the resin.
If spraying, always hold the bottle 12 inches away from the nail.

question.en: Why apply base resin over the activator before filing a dip nail?
question.zh: 浸粉甲锉形之前，为什么要在激活剂上再涂一层底层树脂？

choices.en: To add more color to the nail
To protect the powder during filing
To make the activator smell less

explanation.en: After activator, one more layer of base resin protects the powder during filing and buffing. Because of the activator, this base dries very quickly.
explanation.zh: 上完激活剂后，再涂一层底层树脂，在锉磨和抛光时保护粉层。因为有激活剂，这层底层会干得很快。

lockPoint.en: Like a car's clear coat: scratches hit the clear layer, and the color under it stays safe.
lockPoint.zh: 就像汽车的透明漆层：刮痕落在透明层上，下面的颜色不受伤。

authorityRefs.section: Nail Resin Systems - Dip Systems
Nail Resin Systems - Dip System One-Color Application

evidence.quote: Apply another layer of base resin over the activator to protect the powder application during the filing and buffing.
Because of the activator, the base should dry very quickly.

question.en: After shaping and buffing a dip nail, what comes next?
question.zh: 浸粉甲锉形、抛光之后，接下来做什么？

choices.zh: 先底层树脂，再蘸一次粉
激活剂、擦干净，再上封层树脂

choices.en: Top resin, then cure in a lamp

explanation.en: Apply activator, then clean off the extra with a lint-free wipe. Then brush on top resin, usually two coats: one makes it smooth, one adds shine.
explanation.zh: 先上激活剂，用无尘巾擦掉多余的部分，再刷封层树脂（top resin）。通常刷两层：一层让表面光滑，一层增加亮度。

lockPoint.en: Top resin is the shine coat, so it goes last: activator, wipe, then shine. No lamp needed.
lockPoint.zh: 封层树脂（top resin）负责亮光，所以最后才上：激活剂、擦净，再上亮光。不需要照灯。

authorityRefs.section: Nail Resin Systems - Dip Systems
Nail Resin Systems - Dip System One-Color Application
Nail Resin Systems - Dip System One-Color Application

evidence.quote: After shaping and smoothing the nail, apply a final coat of activator and wipe off with lint free material.
One layer creates a smooth finish; the second layer creates great shine.
Clean the surface with a lint-free wipe to ensure there is no excess activator.
Repeat for a second coat. Let stand for about eight minutes until dry.
without needing an LED or UV lamp

question.en: After removing tips or resin nails, how do you take off leftover residue?
question.zh: 卸掉甲片或树脂甲后，怎样去掉剩下的残留物？

choices.en: Gently buff with a fine-grit buffer
Scrape it with a metal pusher
File it with a coarse-grit abrasive

explanation.en: Milady: gently buff the natural nail with a fine-grit buffer to remove any residue. Then brush away the dust with a clean, dry nail brush.
explanation.zh: Milady 的做法：用细目抛光条（fine-grit buffer）轻轻抛磨真甲，去掉残留物，再用干净、干燥的甲刷扫掉粉尘。

lockPoint.en: Only a little residue is left, so fine grit is enough. Coarse grit is generally not used on natural nails.
lockPoint.zh: 只剩一点残留物，用细目（fine grit）就够了。粗目（coarse grit）一般不用在真甲上。
